evaluatedInput.text:
A documented emergency management program (EMP / ERP) is maintained perCER OPR s. 32. The Northstar EMP includes:
ICS-based command structure
a 24/7 notification matrix to the CER, BCER, AER (where applicable),the local Indigenous nations, and municipal first responders
tier-1/2/3 spill response with mutual-aid agreements
two full-scale exercises annually plus four desktop exercises.
For Alberta-side facilities the program is harmonised with AERDirective 071.

evaluatedInput.text:
Northstar acknowledges the Crown's duty to consult under section 35of the Constitution Act, 1982 (Haida Nation v. British Columbia(Minister of Forests), 2004 SCC 73; Tsleil-Waututh Nation v. Canada,2018 FCA 153). The Indigenous consultation log records bilateralengagement with Treaty 8 First Nations whose territory the gatheringsystem traverses, including:
pre-construction archaeological assessments under each nation's owncultural-heritage protocol
a community benefits agreement with revenue-sharing terms
ongoing quarterly engagement meetings.
The consultation file is maintained by the Indigenous Affairs lead andreviewed by Crown counsel for adequacy.

evaluatedInput.heading: Methane Management
evaluatedInput.heading_path: /Operations & Compliance Program — Northstar NPS 12 Sweet Gas Gathering System/Methane Management
evaluatedInput.text:
The Northstar methane management program implements the federalRegulations Respecting Reduction in the Release of Methane andCertain Volatile Organic Compounds (Upstream Oil and Gas Sector),SOR/2018-66. The program covers:
a leak-detection-and-repair (LDAR) program with quarterly screeningusing OGI cameras at all compressor stations
repair timelines that meet or exceed the 30-day requirement underSOR/2018-66
venting limits at all controlled devices (pneumatic instruments,glycol dehydrators, compressor seals)
methane intensity reporting per OGMP 2.0 reporting framework.
Annual fugitive emissions inventory is filed with ECCC.
